view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a library or co-working area. Wooden arches and shelves contrast with blue-tinted glass walls and glowing vertical lights. People are seated at tables or desks, engaged in work or reading. The floor is polished and reflective, enhancing the bright ambiance.

objects.label: person sitting at desk
objects.observation: A person in a dark jacket sits at a wooden desk on the left, facing away from the camera. They appear to be working on a laptop. Their posture suggests concentration. The desk is partially obscured by an archway behind them.

objects.label: blue glass wall
objects.observation: A large, translucent blue glass wall dominates the background, featuring vertical illuminated strips. It reflects interior lighting and creates a futuristic aesthetic. It separates this area from another space beyond.

objects.label: wooden archway
objects.observation: A curved wooden archway is visible on the left side of the frame, framing part of the scene. It appears to be part of a larger shelving or seating structure. Its warm tone contrasts with the cool blue tones elsewhere.

objects.label: person sitting at table
objects.observation: A person wearing a plaid shirt sits at a white table near the center-right, facing away from the camera. They appear to be using a laptop. A chair is positioned under them, and they are surrounded by other tables and chairs.

objects.label: circular bookshelf
objects.observation: A circular, multi-tiered bookshelf with perforated panels is visible on the right. Books are arranged on its shelves. It has a modern design with integrated lighting along its edge, casting a soft glow.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: A tall green potted plant stands near the center-left, next to the blue glass wall. It is housed in a white cylindrical pot. Its leaves add a natural element to the otherwise modern environment.

objects.label: laptop
objects.observation: A laptop is visible on the desk where the person is seated on the left. The screen is on, but the content is indistinct. The device is positioned for use, suggesting active engagement.

objects.label: white table
objects.observation: A white, round table is located near the center-right, occupied by a person. It has a sleek, minimalist design. Other similar tables are visible nearby, suggesting a communal workspace.

objects.label: chair
objects.observation: A transparent plastic chair is positioned under the table where the person is seated. It has a modern, minimalist design. Another similar chair is visible nearby, indicating multiple seating arrangements.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000028", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
